name: Fort Friendship Day Camp
operator_name: Daniel Webster Council d/b/a Scouting America New Hampshire
description_short: A weekday day camp for children entering grades 1–5 at Camp Carpenter in Manchester, NH. It is open to Scouts and non-Scouts, and activities include daily swimming and boating on a private lake, archery and BB, nature hikes, and crafts.
swim_waterfront_notes: Private lake with daily swimming, boating and waterfront games. Staff are trained in waterfront supervision and swim classification.
